name: Premium home experience and live catalogue signals
description: Checks the redesigned discovery landing page uses live AniList-backed collections and personal library data.
steps: Wait for trending and seasonal collections to load
Review the hero, live signal strip, mood shortcuts and trending shelf
expected: The redesigned home renders without layout errors and shows live counts when AniList collections are available.

name: Browse an anime dossier on mobile
description: Checks the redesigned title profile remains readable and scrollable on a phone.
steps: Open the site at a mobile viewport
Wait for its title dossier to load
Scroll through cast, credits, episode guide and relations
expected: The dossier fits the mobile viewport, remains scrollable and presents available metadata without horizontal overflow.

name: Save an anime and track watch progress
description: Verifies a title can be saved, assigned a watch status, and tracked in the personal library.
steps: Save an anime from its title card
expected: The saved anime, selected status and episode progress remain visible after refresh.

name: Search, filter and sort anime
description: Verifies catalogue discovery controls narrow and reorder results.
steps: Open Filters and choose TV format
expected: The visible catalogue reflects the submitted title search and selected filters and sort order.

name: Handle empty search and mobile navigation
description: Verifies an unmatched search gives a recoverable empty state and mobile navigation remains usable.
steps: Open the site at a mobile viewport
Search for a deliberately unmatched title
Choose Explore anime to return to Discover
expected: An understandable empty state appears without a crash, and the user can return to the discovery catalogue.
